title: WebCMS v1.2.0 Development
instructions: Develop WebCMS v1.2.0 with major new features: real-time collaboration, multi-tenant improvements, content versioning, workflow system, GraphQL API, Redis caching, and enhanced admin UI. Update from current v1.1.0.

log.text: Implemented real-time collaboration system: 1) Created webcms/collaboration package with __init__.py, 2) Implemented OperationalTransformation class for conflict resolution, 3) Created CollaborationManager for session handling, presence tracking, cursor positions, and document locks, 4) Created CollaborationServer for WebSocket connections with authentication, 5) Verified all components work with async test - user join, presence update, lock acquisition, OT transform, server creation

Completed and re-verified real-time collaboration system with multiple concurrent editors test. All 3 users joined successfully, cursor positions tracked, OT transforms concurrent operations, lock conflicts handled correctly.

log.text: Implemented content versioning system in smaller chunks: 1) Created webcms/versioning package, 2) Added Version model with history tracking, 3) Created DiffViewer with text/HTML/word/structured diff support, 4) Implemented VersionManager with create/list/rollback/compare/delete/prune/audit-trail, 5) Added REST API endpoints for versions, 6) Verified with async test showing version creation, comparison, rollback, and audit trail all working

Re-confirmed content versioning system is complete: Version model, DiffViewer, VersionManager, and API endpoints all implemented and tested. Version creation, comparison, rollback, pruning, and audit trail verified working.

1783834044.7507782.instruction:
1. Create Workflow model with states (draft, review, approved, published)
2. Implement approval chains with multiple reviewers
3. Add notification system for workflow events
4. Create workflow editor UI in admin
5. Add scheduled publishing
6. Implement content calendar view
7. Add workflow permissions and roles

log.text: Implemented workflow system: 1) Created webcms/workflow package with models (WorkflowState, WorkflowTransition, WorkflowDefinition, WorkflowInstance), 2) Added NotificationManager for workflow events, 3) Created WorkflowManager with default editorial workflow, transitions, reviewer assignment, scheduled publishing, and content calendar, 4) Added REST API endpoints for workflow operations, 5) Verified with test_workflow.py showing full workflow from draft → review → approved → published and notifications generated

Implemented GraphQL system: 1) Set up Graphene schema in webcms/graphql, 2) Created GraphQL types for users, posts, pages, media, categories, tags, versions, workflows, 3) Implemented queries for content/users/media/search/workflows/versions, 4) Added CRUD mutations for posts and pages, 5) Created GraphiQL explorer endpoint at /graphiql, 6) Added field-level permission middleware, 7) Implemented query complexity limiting middleware, 8) Added subscription scaffolding with SubscriptionManager. Verified with test_graphql.py showing queries and mutations work.

Implemented Redis caching system: 1) Added RedisClient with connection pooling, 2) Implemented DistributedLock for distributed locking, 3) Created CacheWarmer for background warming tasks, 4) Built CacheAnalytics dashboard with stats/memory/top keys, 5) Added query result caching with cache_manager.cache_query, 6) Implemented RedisSessionStore, 7) Created CacheInvalidator with content/taxonomy/user/all invalidation patterns, 8) Added admin routes for analytics/invalidate/warm. Verified with test_cache.py using mock Redis.

Implemented multi-tenant system: 1) Created Tenant model with TenantQuota for isolation and resource limits, 2) Built TenantRouter with contextvars for tenant-aware database routing and middleware, 3) Added tenant-specific themes and plugin management, 4) Created full TenantAPI with CRUD, theme, plugin endpoints, 5) Implemented cross-tenant content sharing, 6) Added tenant analytics dashboard endpoint, 7) Created backup/restore functionality, 8) Added quota checking. Verified with test_tenants.py showing tenant creation, routing, theme/plugins, sharing, analytics, backup/restore, and quotas.

Implemented modern admin frontend: 1) Set up Vite build system with package.json, vite.config.js, and index.html, 2) Created component library with Button, Card, Layout components, 3) Implemented drag-and-drop page builder using @dnd-kit with sortable blocks, 4) Added rich text editor with ReactMarkdown live preview, 5) Created media gallery with bulk select/delete operations, 6) Implemented dark mode toggle with ThemeContext and CSS variables, 7) Added keyboard shortcuts (save/new/darkmode/close) via react-hotkeys-hook, 8) Added responsive mobile admin CSS with media queries. Verified file tree structure.

Implemented Elasticsearch search system: 1) Added ElasticsearchClient with connection management, 2) Created SearchIndexer for index/document management, 3) Built Searcher with multi_match queries, highlighting, aggregations for facets, filters (status/author/tags/date), fuzzy matching, pagination, and suggestions, 4) Added SearchAnalytics for query tracking, popular queries, and suggestions, 5) Created SearchAPI with /search, /suggest, /analytics, and index management endpoints, 6) Implemented faceted search UI in admin-ui/src/pages/Search.jsx with filters, suggestions, and facet navigation. Verified search analytics with test_search.py.

Implemented notification system: 1) Created template engine with default email templates (welcome, password_reset, workflow_review, daily_digest), 2) Implemented SMTPAdapter and SendGridAdapter, 3) Added per-user NotificationPreferences with email/in_app/push channels, 4) Created daily/weekly digest email dispatch, 5) Built in-app notification center with read tracking, 6) Added push notification handler registration, 7) Created NotificationAPI with endpoints for notifications, preferences, digests, and queue management, 8) Implemented EmailQueue with retry logic. Verified with test_notifications.py showing queue processing, digests, and in-app notifications.

Implemented backup and disaster recovery system: 1) Created BackupScheduler for automated recurring backups, 2) Built BackupEngine with full and incremental database backups, 3) Added media backup support with S3Storage, AzureStorage, and LocalStorage backends, 4) Implemented backup verification with checksum validation, 5) Created one-click restore via RestoreManager, 6) Added BackupEncryption using Fernet/AES, 7) Wrote DISASTER_RECOVERY.md documentation, 8) Built BackupMonitor for backup health and alerts. Verified with test_backup.py showing full/incremental backups, verification, restore, encryption, scheduling, and monitoring.

Completed testing, documentation, and deployment artifacts: 1) Created integration tests for workflow, tenants, cache, notifications, backup, and GraphQL, 2) Added unit tests for workflow models, tenant models, notification templates, backup encryption, and GraphQL types, 3) Added Locust and k6 load testing scripts, 4) Wrote OpenAPI/Swagger documentation in docs/api/openapi.yaml, 5) Created user guides for workflow and search features, 6) Added 3 architecture decision records (workflow, multi-tenancy, search), 7) Set up pytest and coverage reporting in pyproject.toml with realistic fail_under target, 8) Created Docker Compose deployment guide and DEPLOYMENT.md, 9) Added performance benchmarking suite with cache and analytics benchmarks. Verified 25 new tests pass. Also added ContentIndexer compatibility alias and imghdr compatibility shim to fix existing test collection errors.
